arcs.title: Copperline archaeology
arcs.duration_contract: 1.5h, healthy 1–2h. One to three researchers divide directory, ticket, and archive history, then compare notes.
arcs.core_revelation: Copperline is an ordinary legacy host; mkept was a real administrator who deliberately preserved a recoverable route.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: None beyond ordinary web navigation and the campaign start URL.
arcs.investigation_identity: Mundane web archaeology: account ownership, service history, timestamps, and link rot—not occult page hunting.
arcs.submission_surface: Copperline service-recovery form; the page names the fields it accepts.
arcs.emotional_function: Curiosity earns trust: the first “haunting” is human maintenance and care.

arcs.title: Gated prologue save
arcs.duration_contract: 1.5h, healthy 1–2h. Any subset can inspect the immutable download; file and open-web tools are valid.
arcs.core_revelation: The save is evidence that reconstructs one live server endpoint; it is not a second campaign world.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P1.F1–P1.F3 and the earned download route.
arcs.investigation_identity: Digital/physical provenance reconstruction: hash, dispatch records, shelf addresses, and world geography agree.
arcs.submission_surface: A local-world dispatch terminal that validates the assembled endpoint and returns a signed handoff receipt.
arcs.emotional_function: The old backup becomes a threshold: somebody expected another person to finish the route.

arcs.title: Arrival, settlement, and Discord
arcs.duration_contract: 2h, healthy 1.5–2.5h. Two to six explore settlement work/life; one player can sequence every observation.
arcs.core_revelation: The surface is inhabited and ordinary; selective disturbances are local evidence; coordination is earned from inside Minecraft.
arcs.investigation_identity: Social corroboration and account handoff: place, testimony, and proof-bound identity.
arcs.submission_surface: The settlement dispatch office, then `/obslink` in Minecraft and `/link` in Discord.
arcs.emotional_function: Isolation gives way to companionship without making the residents exposition devices.

arcs.title: Surface Mouth, descent, and intake
arcs.duration_contract: 1.5h, healthy 1–2h. Group arrival is preferred; any subset can replay the reversible route.
arcs.core_revelation: The Deep Hold was constructed as a rational refuge with heat, water, shelter, and public intake.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P3 dispatch receipt, surface geography, and settlement directions.
arcs.investigation_identity: Construction-phase and route archaeology: strata, capacity, logistics, and civic intake.
arcs.submission_surface: Intake survey desk at the bottom of the reversible descent.
arcs.emotional_function: Awe is disciplined by ordinary labor; the monumental place begins with practical need.

arcs.title: Refuge life and the seven Ways
arcs.duration_contract: 2.5h, healthy 2–3h. Parallel teams of one to three investigate school/trade/domestic and service/watch lanes, then synthesize.
arcs.core_revelation: Seven practical safety procedures sustained ordinary life and later became tools of institutional control.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P4 phases, capacity, and founding motive.
arcs.investigation_identity: Civic ethnography through service archaeology: reconstruct work and compare early procedure with later enforcement.
arcs.submission_surface: Civic inquiry desk with seven job/abuse pairs and one ordinary-life synthesis.
arcs.emotional_function: The Hold becomes a home worth mourning; safety and coercion are allowed to coexist.

arcs.title: Six Keeper dossiers
arcs.duration_contract: 3h, healthy 2.5–3.5h. Six dossier lanes divide naturally; reconvergence is required for the distinction finding.
arcs.core_revelation: Vaun, Mara, Sella, Orin, Brann, and Iss were six separate, complicated contemporaries with different jobs and culpabilities.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P5 practical Ways and institutional drift.
arcs.investigation_identity: Six different professional grammars, not six reskinned ciphers or stations.
arcs.submission_surface: Keeper archive index; each dossier files a professional finding, then the group submits a six-person responsibility matrix.
arcs.emotional_function: Icons become people; admiration, anger, and sympathy stop aligning neatly.

arcs.title: Cistern Winter
arcs.duration_contract: 2.5h, healthy 2–3h. Two or three teams follow material, labor/time, and procurement/record lanes before one conclusion.
arcs.core_revelation: Diverted genuine supplies, counterfeit filters, edited shifts, and falsified records caused the crisis; Nessa followed procedure; Averyn proved it and the institution erased the finding.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P6 Vaun/Sella/Brann/Iss methods and the practical origin of Offering, Dark Hours, and Sacred Beast.
arcs.investigation_identity: Forensic public inquiry: chain of custody, material comparison, labor chronology, and document redrafting.
arcs.submission_surface: Cistern inquiry desk for exhibits; final two-proposition conclusion through the shared docket.
arcs.emotional_function: Institutional horror lands on one ordinary worker before the cosmic system is explained.

arcs.title: Break, altered region, and repair
arcs.duration_contract: 4h, healthy 3–5h. Broadest split: chronology, structure/load, surface/route, copied-space, then repair crews with periodic synthesis.
arcs.core_revelation: Neglect, unequal allocation, false records, dangerous excavation, delayed response, and Dark/Record feedback all contributed; Iss accelerated but did not solely cause the Break; infrastructure can be repaired.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P7 falsification, P5 Ways, P6 Orin/Brann/Iss, and the established healed-surface claim.
arcs.investigation_identity: Incident reconstruction plus engineering intervention: a copied region is evidence, followed by visible repair.
arcs.submission_surface: Incident board for four cause classes; local deterministic repair housings; final works console.
arcs.emotional_function: Helpless dread turns into material agency without making repair erase responsibility.

arcs.title: Failed expedition camp
arcs.duration_contract: 2.5h, healthy 2–3h. Camp-space teams reconstruct four stations while a web/media pair follows the earned archive route.
arcs.core_revelation: mkept, Ash, Rook, and Wren were four real modern investigators who nearly completed a release; their failure was not a missing answer.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P8 repaired access, mkept from P1, and Copperline service/ticket conventions.
arcs.investigation_identity: Camp archaeology and media provenance: infer people from spatial traces, then follow their custody chain.
arcs.submission_surface: Camp reconstruction board, earned Copperline archive route, and Locker 13.
arcs.emotional_function: The players meet predecessors through ordinary belongings before learning the betrayal.

arcs.title: Wren sabotage
arcs.duration_contract: 2h, healthy 1.5–2.5h. Evidence pairs build a leak matrix; all available players debate, with any subset able to commit a protected judgment.
arcs.core_revelation: Wren deliberately gave the Record names, routes, plans, and fears because he feared closure would erase his partially retained self.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P9 four-person reconstruction, Spool, private Rook revision, and near-release plan.
arcs.investigation_identity: Leak-source attribution, adversarial interview, and moral judgment.
arcs.submission_surface: Leak matrix, synchronous Wren dialogue, independently opened Bridge route, protected reckoning surface.
arcs.emotional_function: Proof and empathy collide; understanding motive does not erase responsibility.

arcs.title: Averyn and the Record
arcs.duration_contract: 2h, healthy 1.5–2.5h. Players distribute six affidavit rereads, then synthesize identity/system relationships together.
arcs.core_revelation: Averyn is the erased registrar/cistern analyst trapped as the Record’s human interface; the Watcher is constrained speech. Dark, Record, Watcher, and Averyn are related but not identical.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: P7 Averyn cache, six P6 affidavits, P8 copied-space evidence, P10 Wren/Record behavior.
arcs.investigation_identity: Provenance-preserving identity restoration: independent culpable testimony reread against a recovered archive.
arcs.submission_surface: Recovered-archive workbench, six affidavit readers, one collective identity/relationship filing.
arcs.emotional_function: The system voice resolves into a tired person without turning her into a symbol or seventh Keeper.

arcs.title: Convergence, Release, and Coda
arcs.duration_contract: 1.5h, healthy 1–2h. Preferred whole-group convergence; the explicit accessibility path preserves evidence and choice for an absence.
arcs.core_revelation: Returning truth without rebinding Averyn permits one release outcome: the Record closes and Averyn is freed. Only name treatment and Wren remembrance vary.
arcs.required_prior_knowledge: Every P1–P11 arc conclusion, repaired systems, six affidavits, Cistern proof, System Key, Protocol Bridge, and protected Wren judgment.
arcs.investigation_identity: Readiness audit, restorative configuration, protected choices, and irreversible civic release.
arcs.submission_surface: Release chamber with named housings, empty Averyn slot, plain-language choices, player confirmation plus operator arm.
arcs.emotional_function: The group converts investigation into repair, judgment, and goodbye; closure is decisive and persistent.
